verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Gunderson Dettmer publishing on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments or local rules such as UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE. The equity-compensation page describes generic and US-style instruments (ISOs/NSOs, RSUs, phantom stock), which is an adjacent service, not market-specific publishing. Offices in São Paulo, Singapore and Beijing show international presence but no published guidance on local instruments, and the Catalyze Knowledge Hub is client-exclusive with no evidence of such content.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE
